testcase.name: newest events are kept and the list is bounded()
catching up is not slowed down()
a feed that failed is not a feed with nothing in it()
the cursor advances instead of staying at zero()
a truncated page catches up immediately()
a restored cursor resumes instead of replaying everything()
the envelope never makes a stretched backoff exceed the ceiling()
a device with minutes left stops polling rather than polling slowly()
a cursor is saved so a restart does not replay()
failures back off exponentially and stop at a ceiling()
a constrained device polls the event stream less often()
an overlapping page does not produce duplicate rows()
catch-up is immediate because the constant is zero, and that is load-bearing()
the default pressure changes nothing for a caller that has no reading()
